title: Train / overlap / serial land (tmux, fake forge, level a): two clean PRs editing one shared file stay together in a train and a third PR on the same line drops as a conflict; a red train lands nothing and no successor builds on it; a successor built on the predecessor's tested tip waits for it, then lands on its final squash; under one land lock each member lands in order at its exact tested head, the squash on the tested main with the train step's tree; a member head moved mid-land is refused at the forge and a default branch moved mid-land stops the train and rebuilds the successor on the new main; every draft train PR is closed and its branch deleted
